_comment: Long-episode variant of generator.example_even.json: same style balancing, but lengths spread evenly over 5..30 instead of 4..8. The point is the history the agent has to carry -- at length 30 a back reference may be pointing 25 instructions back, where the 4-8 set never asked for more than 7. The even spread over six lengths also gives an SR-against-episode-length curve rather than a single number. 58 episodes generated to land near 50 after the builder drops what it cannot place.
